recentItems.title: Next Stop LA28! 🇨🇳🤸‍♀️ Team China Trains at the Artistic Gymnastics World Championships 2026
recentItems.description:
Team China have shown up to podium practice at Rotterdam 2026 looking sharp and hungry for the medals. The Artistic Gymnastics World Championships take place from October 17th to 25th 2026, in Rotterdam Ahoy. Over nine days, the world’s best male and female gymnasts will compete for medals in team, all-around, and apparatus events!

recentItems.title: "I said I would never ever date another gymnast" 🇳🇱🤸‍♀️🇿🇦 | Casimir Schmidt & Naveen Daries
recentItems.description:
We sat down with Olympic gymnasts Casimir Schmidt of the Netherlands and Naveen Daries of South Africa to talk all things love and gymnastics: from how they met and their first date to navigating a long-distance relationship, balancing training, and their journeys through Tokyo 2020, Paris 2024 and looking ahead to LA28.
